constraints.name: automation_service_companies_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT is_deleted) OR ((deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_by IS NOT NULL) AND (delete_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM delete_reason)) >= 3))))

constraints.name: automation_service_credential_events_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((actor_kind = 'OWNER'::text) AND (actor_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (actor_credential_id IS NULL)) OR ((actor_kind = 'SERVICE'::text) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (actor_credential_id = credential_id)) OR ((actor_kind = 'UNAUTHENTICATED'::text) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (actor_credential_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: automation_service_credentials_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT is_deleted) OR ((deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_by IS NOT NULL) AND (delete_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM delete_reason)) >= 3))))

constraints.name: automation_service_credentials_label_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM label)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM label)) <= 120)))
